title: Law to let people sue AI companies for third-party misuse harms
summary: This bill would let a person sue an artificial intelligence company when a third party misuses its AI model to cause foreseeable harm in New York City and the company failed to put in place reasonable safeguards against such misuse. Remedies could include damages, punitive damages and injunctive relief. The bill applies to any company that makes an AI model available for commercial or public use and would take effect immediately upon enactment.
